goals.note: The default calorie target is an example only. Users should adjust it to their own needs.

tips.title: Check the full picture
tips.text: Compare calories with protein, carbohydrates, fat and serving size instead of judging a food by one number.

tips.title: Use a realistic portion
tips.text: Nutrition values are calculated from the selected product's reported values per 100 g. The amount you eat changes the total.

tips.title: Treat database values as estimates
tips.text: Product information may be missing or user-submitted. Check the package label when accuracy matters.

tips.title: Build variety into meals
tips.text: A useful eating pattern includes a variety of foods. One food or nutrient does not determine overall diet quality.
